CLOSING-ALLOWANCE HANDOVER, STOP CONDITION TRIGGERED (Ruling 70 R1 gate check not ready) plus a scope burst (5 regressions in a test file I may not edit). NOTHING COMMITTED. Route pre-check: requested claude-sonnet-5-5/xhigh, observed claude-sonnet-5-5 (runtime prompt); effort not observable; no contradiction.

1. DoD results
- 11 ENFORCEMENT cases green: PASSED (native cheap loop: 14 pass, 0 fail, 1 todo; WSL AFTER capture lists no ENFORCEMENT case among its failures).
- Nothing green before is red after: FAILED. 5 cases of pipeline-start-preflight.test.mjs went green to red: F2 (:1639), F4(c) (:1657), F4(a) (:1672), PX0-AC-08(b), PHX-WP-AAC01-MULTISESSION. Four were read: each asserts status 'ready' and now gets 'hook-refresh-required'. The fifth was not inspected individually. Cause: these cases call the real preflight with the real default checkCloneProvisioning, which reads THIS repo's installed hooks; those hooks read 'refresh' against the repo copy of the plugin, so the ratified enforcement fires. The cases are not hermetic. Fixing them is a test-file edit, outside my scope (stop condition 3).
- Key-list case: not in the AFTER failure list (it was red BEFORE); head at capture was 6259c35cc, so TESTFIX-B may have landed. Not verified, not chased.
- Ruling 70 R1 gate check: FAILED. The real repo-copy preflight with no role printed status 'plugin-refresh-required' (exit code 0 by the allowlist), not 'ready'. My diff cannot have caused it: planMandatoryHookRefresh returns the status unchanged unless the base status is 'ready', and the base status is computed earlier. I could not run a pre-change comparison (no stash, no worktree allowed). The guard-prescribed marketplace-copy preflight, run before my first write, printed 'ready'. Per R1 I STOPPED without committing. Also: all three repo hooks read 'refresh' against the repo copy, so if the base status were 'ready' a no-role Elephant run here would be hook-refresh-required, exit 2 (the R1 hazard, S3 territory).
- Consumer-safe check: PASSED (exit 0).
- R2 consumers: no protected consumer needs a change. freshnessHostActionForPreflight (:796) returns null for any status other than 'ready' (fail closed, tolerates the new status; under stale hooks the freshness binding is now null where it used to bind). ruleset-freshness-host.mjs:231 calls observePreflight() with no seam (plain object, unchanged). command-catalogue.mjs:272 is a sync call with no seam and only reads nextAction; attestation actions require base status plugin-attestation-required, which the enforcement never touches.
- R3 (real bootstrap writes): runEntry ran it once with confirm=null: modelRoleBootstrap = { status: 'unavailable', code: 'MODEL-ROLE-BOOTSTRAP-STORE-UNAVAILABLE' }. git status afterwards shows no file attributable to it. Host-store writes are not observable within my read limits: NOT independently verifiable, not claimed as passed.
- R5: pre-push applyInstall is exported (pre-push-hook-install.mjs:705), so the helper refreshes pre-push too; only 'ready-to-upgrade' plans with updateRequired === true are ever applied.

2. Evidence
- node --test plugins/pipeline-core/scripts/pipeline-start-preflight-enforcement.test.mjs: exit 0 (terminal output only, no artifact file).
- WSL capture-evidence of both test files: evidence/HOOKREFRESH-F1b-20261009/after-preflight.txt (exitCode 1 recorded in the file, head 6259c35cc); 93 tests, 85 pass, 5 fail, 3 todo. BEFORE: 93/78/12/3 at head 410d0addf.
- node plugins/pipeline-core/scripts/pipeline-start-preflight.mjs (repo copy, no role): exit 0, status plugin-refresh-required (terminal output only).
- node --test harness/scripts/check-consumer-safe-paths.test.mjs: exit 0, 9 pass.

3. Changed files (UNCOMMITTED, nothing staged)
- plugins/pipeline-core/scripts/pipeline-start-preflight.mjs (modified): role and runModelRoleBootstrapFn options, planMandatoryHookRefresh, conditional-thenable attachModelRoleBootstrap, main()/runEntry role and readback plumbing, lenient --role parser.
- plugins/pipeline-core/scripts/refresh-mandatory-hooks.mjs (new, untracked): the refresh helper.

4. Deliberately not changed: every test file, hooks/ and guard files, scripts/model-role-bootstrap.mjs, the foreign staged and unstaged files of parallel dispatches, check-clone-provisioning.mjs, clone-hook-readiness.mjs.

5. Deviations: the opening record was not read back after the Write (the tool confirmed creation; budget); the AFTER capture label is HOOKREFRESH-F1b-after.

6. Open items: stop condition R1 triggered; scope burst (5 non-hermetic tests); independent review: pending; verify: partial; PO acceptance: open. Not tested: after the helper runs on the stale+missing mix, readiness is [current, install]; clone-hook-readiness --apply refuses with HOOK-READINESS-PLAN-DRIFT for any non-install entry, and the action's expected status 'ready' cannot hold, so the repair stays two-step there. The helper's guard admission (S3) and the --role text in the guard message are still open.
